title: American Rice Stick Noodle Dish
description: A comforting and chewy American dish featuring rice stick noodles, kombu cold extract, and a low calorie friendly twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice stick noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the kombu cold extract and low sodium soy sauce.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Pour the kombu cold extract mixture over the noodles and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
